title: Fake-DOM move: FakeElement family (chat / observation / flight-companion / lin-2933 / sentinel-mask / chart-helpers / lin-4035 / live-console) with stop rule
description:
Plan piece 6, step B.

Candidates: the `chat-*` suites with their own `FakeElement`/`FakeClassList` (for example `chat-render-markdown-text`, `chat-tool-rows`), the observation family through the shared `tests/fixtures/observation-dom-shim.js` (review note 5: deleting the fixture takes one entry off the list, not three), `flight-companion-client`, `lin-2933-cross-seam-witness`, `task-chat-flight-companion-sentinel-mask`, `chart-helpers`, `lin-4035-live-console-client` and `live-console-client-facts`. Use the census list from S1 as the source of truth for which files are in this family.

* **Stop rule, decided in the plan.** For each suite, check whether every DOM API its client uses is modelled once `className`/`id` are in. A suite stays on the census list, with the API named in the PR, if its client needs `style`, `getBoundingClientRect`, scroll behaviour beyond a plain expando, or real event dispatch or bubbling. Expect `live-console` to stop on `style` ×10 and `getBoundingClientRect` ×3. `observation`/`common` (`dispatchEvent`, `insertAdjacentHTML`) are decided one by one. Expect a partial move, not zero. The fake must not become a layout engine.

**Done when:** each suite in the family is either moved (same test names and counts, census entry removed) or stopped (API named). The fake's header lists its current consumers.

---

**Where the scope and design live.** Parent: LIN-4255. Read its description's **Implementation Plan** (the approved plan) and the Plan Review Verdict comment `98a20bc0-f43b-406c-bb64-8ce22860b08f`, which has notes for the builder. The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts. Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4255.

* Session fit: answered by the plan below (the family is 17 suites plus the fixture, not about 10, and the plan splits it into pieces).
* Review of the approved parent plan: LIN-4255's approving plan-review (comment 98a20bc0-f43b-406c-bb64-8ce22860b08f, rev 1). It does not cover the course change in the plan below; that plan has its own review flag.
* Grounding commit: `b5391736` (LinearViewer origin/main; still HEAD when this breakdown was made on 2026-11-05).

**Rules for every move piece (from the plan):** test names and counts stay the same. Before and after, run `node --test --test-reporter=spec <file>` and paste the empty diff. Remove each moved file from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and from the `fake-dom.js` header's consumer list in the same PR. Delete both copies, the container and the `vm` sandbox. Never loosen an assertion that reads fake internals: map it to a real-DOM replacement and prove the replacement goes red under the mutation it guards. Every red is a finding, and the PR records it as fixed, filed or fake artefact. Serializer differences (`disabled=""`, escaping) are fixed in the test's regexes, never by relaxing the fake. Out of scope: the 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js`.

## Implementation Plan

**Close-out stub (2026-11-05).** Implemented as approved, via seven child PRs: #2303 (piece 0, shared-fake additions, `aeb9d877`), #2304 (piece 1, `82e75ee9`), #2307, #2308, #2309, #2310 and #2311 (pieces 2 to 6, head `1b83bbff`). 16 of 17 suites moved onto `loadWorld` (444 tests, names and counts identical); `flight-companion-client` stopped on `style` plus layout read-back; `observation-dom-shim.js` deleted. Deviation: the census ended at 25 entries, not the plan's 40, because the plan's arithmetic predated the sibling moves (corrected in LIN-4281). The plan's per-piece detail, additions list, name-and-count tables, risks, and the team question (answered yes) are archived in the task snapshots and the comment trail. The Verdicts and Fake-internals sections are kept because LIN-4290 cites them.

*Read at* `473cc865` *(origin/main HEAD; LIN-4270 and LIN-4266 are both merged). Beat 1 listed the family, beat 2 priced it, beat 3 re-ran the claims below. Course-change note on the parent: LIN-4255 comment* `b4a44c2e-1ce0-4108-a524-eb94c3abfaee`*.*

### The problem, and what done looks like

17 client suites still hand-write a `FakeElement` and their own `vm` sandbox: the 15 FakeElement-family census entries (16 with the shared fixture `tests/fixtures/observation-dom-shim.js`) plus `observation-scope` and `observation-waiting-host`, which import the fixture but are not on the census. The shared fake (`tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`) now has `className`/`id` (LIN-4270), so the old blocker is gone.

**Done when:** every suite in the family is either moved onto `createFakeDom`/`loadWorld` with its test names and counts unchanged and its census entry removed and its name added to the `fake-dom.js` header consumer list, or stopped with the missing API named in the PR; the fixture is deleted if all three importers moved; and the fake's header lists its consumers and its additions, current. Census at HEAD is 55 files; the target is 40 (or 48 if the team declines the fake additions, see the question below).

### Fake-internals assertions: replacements and the mutations that must turn them red

Each replacement is proven red under the mutation it guards, in the PR; one that cannot go red is a loosening and does not count.

* `chat-render-markdown-text`: `el.innerHTML === null` ("never assigned") becomes `innerHTML === ''`, no children, original `textContent` kept. Mutation: assign `renderMarkdown`'s output on a no-op path (`chat.js:643`).
* `chat-tool-rows`: `deepEqual(groupRows(g), [a.li, b.li])` becomes per-node `strictEqual` (the real `children` returns a fresh array). Mutation: skip grouping in `appendToolRow`.
* `chart-helpers`: `canvas.replacedBy` becomes "the container has one child with the empty-state text and `canvas.isConnected === false`". Mutation: delete `canvas.replaceWith(empty)` (`chart-helpers.js:109`). "Cells are text, not markup" (test `:231-234`) was vacuous before and must fail if the client used `innerHTML`.
* `lin-4035`: `FakeEl.children`/`textOf`/`_attrs` become `textContent`, `querySelector('.lc-timeline-detail-task')`, `getAttribute`. Mutation: drop the task link (`live-console.js:276`) or the open-run/open-task links (`:279-280`). The server markup ships `hidden` and `aria-expanded="false"`, so the "collapsed" tests parse the page with those un-set first, or they pass without a client write.
* `live-console-client-facts`: `anchors[sel] === undefined` becomes `querySelector(sel) === null`. The "reused node" test becomes `classList.contains('lc-lane--pulse')`. Mutation (run in beat 3): invert `li.classList.toggle('lc-lane--pulse', !reducedMotion)` (`live-console.js:1282`); the test goes red.
* `sentinel-mask`: `savedList.children[0].innerHTML` (a tautological echo) becomes the `.task-chat-saved-meta`/`-title` text and an `outerHTML` that has no sentinel. Mutation: drop the mask at `task-chat.js:202`, `:203` or `:69`.
* `lin-2933`: `buttons.forEach` passes with zero buttons; assert `buttons.length > 0` and draw the real row. Mutation: delete the re-enable loop in `restore()` (`observation.js:3551`).
* `observation-ruling-delivery`: `document.activeElement = box` becomes `box.focus()`; add `reason.blur()` before the repaint or the shelve-panel hold (`observation.js:2142`) stops being tested. `scan-due`: `list.innerHTML` regexes become `input.obs-due-select[data-issue-id="a"].checked`; mutation `insertAdjacentHTML` to `innerHTML` turns the append test red. `waiting-block`: the `{ innerHTML: '' }` objects become the client's own `makeSessionCard`; mutation `section.hidden = false`. `scope`: exact-selector overrides become real buttons; mutation: invert the chip toggle.
* `card-order`: `children.map(el => el.__id)` becomes `el.dataset.session`. The mutation "delete the whole `!frozen` guard" already survives today; record it, do not fix it here.

Serializer differences (`disabled=""`, `hidden=""`, `checked=""`, escaping, a parse error on malformed markup or `<!doctype>`) are fixed in the test's regexes or fixtures, never by relaxing the fake. Every red a real tree raises is recorded in the PR as fixed, filed, or fake artefact.

### Out of scope

The 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js` (none of these suites loads that file; LIN-4272 files the follow-up); `select` support in the fake; `style`, `getBoundingClientRect`, scroll behaviour and real event dispatch; moving `flight-companion-client`; the other census files not in this family (LIN-4272 classifies them).

### Session fit

needs multiple sessions

Seven PRs, each verified on its own (piece 0, then pieces 1 to 6 above), each ending with a shorter census list or a tested fake. I would make them child tickets of LIN-4271 so each is dispatched and closed on its own; piece 1 can run in parallel with piece 0, and pieces 2 to 6 wait for piece 0.

plan-review due: yes

The review should check the course change on LIN-4255, the additions list in piece 0, and that the fallback is acceptable.

- chat (client `public/chat.js`, `task-chat.js`): `tests/unit/chat-append-options.test.js` (16), `chat-render-markdown-text.test.js` (7), `chat-tool-rows.test.js` (12)

**Copies.** There is no shared `makeContainer` here. Each suite carries its own `FakeElement` class (or object literals) *and* its own `makeSandbox`/`load`/`vm.createContext`, in the same file; the "container" and "vm sandbox" copies are those two blocks per suite. The only cross-file copy is the observation fixture.

**Shared-fake APIs at HEAD.** `createFakeDom()` gives `document` (`createElement`, `body`, `documentElement`, `activeElement`) with: tree ops (`appendChild`, `insertBefore`, `removeChild`, `remove`, `replaceWith`, `contains`, `textContent`, `children`/`childNodes`/`parentNode`), `innerHTML`/`outerHTML` get+set, attributes, `className`/`id`, `classList` (add/remove/toggle/contains), `dataset`, `hidden`/`disabled`/`type`/`checked`/`value`, selectors (type, class, id, `[attr]`, `[attr=v]`, descendant, `>`, comma, `:not`, `:scope`), `matches`/`closest`, focus/blur, `addEventListener`/`removeEventListener`/`listenersOf`, and an inert `dispatchEvent`. **Not present** (grep of `fake-dom.js`): `style`, `scrollTop`/`scrollHeight` (a plain expando would work), `getBoundingClientRect`, `insertAdjacentHTML`, `replaceChild`, `replaceChildren`, `firstChild`/`lastChild`/siblings, `createTextNode`, `document.getElementById`, `cloneNode`, `append`/`prepend`, `element.click()`.

**Stale or contradicted in the ticket**
1. "About 10 files plus the fixture" is low: the census lists 15 suites + the fixture. The extra ones are the observation suites that carry their *own* `FakeElement` or canned stubs (`basis-check`, `bulk-scan`, `card-order`, `ruling-delivery`, `scan-due`, `waiting-block`), not just the shim.
2. "Deleting the fixture takes one entry off the list" is true for the census, but three suites import it: `observation-waiting-block`, `observation-scope` and `observation-waiting-host`. The last two are not on the census (the shim is the only entry), so deleting the fixture means moving or re-homing all three. `waiting-block` is also listed on its own for canned stubs.
3. "Remove moved files from the `fake-dom.js` header consumer list" is backwards. Per the LIN-4265 comment `b6dfed3e`, a moved suite *leaves* `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and *joins* the header's consumer list. The header consumer section was only added by LIN-4265 (the plan assumed it existed).
4. "Delete both copies (container and `vm`)" is shaped for the `makeContainer` family; here it means each suite's own fake class and its own `makeSandbox`. `loadWorld` fixes the sandbox globals (`window`, `document`, timers, `fetch`, etc.) and takes `globals` for extras, but `document` has only the fake's surface (above).
5. The "expect `live-console` to stop on `style` ×10, `getBoundingClientRect` ×3" claim checks out against `public/live-console.js` (10 and 3). It also holds for two things the ticket did not name: `flight-companion.js` has `.style` ×3 (with `scrollTop`/`scrollHeight` ×9, which are expandos) and `observation.js` has `getElementById` ×59, plus `insertAdjacentHTML` ×1 and `replaceChild` ×2, none of which the shared fake models. Beat 2 prices each against the suite's actual calls, not the client's whole file.
6. Nothing in the ticket contradicts the parent plan; the plan's "fake lacks `className`/`id`" gap is closed by LIN-4270.

Beat 2 classifies each suite (move / stop on a named API); beat 3 writes the plan, including whether it splits by sub-family.
